purpose: Budget evidence for the bounded synthetic AirlineDemo rehearsal configuration.

authorization.note: This record estimates a bounded configuration and does not authorize provisioning, spending, alerts, or an applied deployment.

pricingBasis.method: PAYG list-price planning rates in USD, before tax, credits, negotiated discounts and currency conversion.
pricingBasis.regionRule: Use Sweden Central regional meters where published. Where a service publishes a global or dynamic rate card, the cited Microsoft pricing page is the source and the recorded rate is a conservative planning allowance.
pricingBasis.reconciliationRule: Every regional meter used by the estimate is identified by meterId/skuId in the dated snapshot. A line-item planning allowance may exceed the returned tier rate only where the formula says so; an unavailable or changed meter blocks apply and requires a refreshed estimate.
pricingBasis.validationBeforeApply: Confirm the exact Azure OpenAI model/version, Document Intelligence availability, and all selected meters in the Azure pricing calculator or Retail Prices API immediately before any apply. A rate above a recorded allowance requires a revised estimate and approval.

sources.note: Consumption plan vCPU-second and GiB-second pricing; scale-to-zero removes replica compute while idle.
Basic registry daily service charge, image storage and registry operations.
Hot LRS block blob capacity and transaction pricing.
General Purpose serverless compute, storage and backup pricing.
Read/page-metered pricing; regional availability remains a preflight check.
Input and output token meters. The model/version is intentionally not selected in the preflight record.
Analytics log ingestion and retention pricing.
Internet egress pricing; ingress is assumed free.
Use armRegionName=swedencentral and the selected service/SKU filters to refresh regional meters.

usageAssumptions.rehearsalPattern: Two five-run consecutive rehearsal blocks satisfy the parent readiness bar; two additional runs cover setup and fallback rehearsal.

lineItems.configuration: Consumption plan, scale-to-zero, zero minimum replicas, one maximum replica, 0.5 vCPU and 1 GiB per replica.
lineItems.costFormula: 43200 vCPU-seconds x 0.000024 USD + 86400 GiB-seconds x 0.000003 USD = 1.296 USD, rounded up = 1.30 USD.

lineItems.configuration: One Basic registry, one retained application image GB and 120 image pulls per month; images are retained for 30 days.
lineItems.unit: registry-month plus image storage and operations
lineItems.costFormula: 1 Basic registry x 5.01 USD/month + 1 GB image storage x 0.01 USD = 5.02 USD; image pulls remain within the Basic allowance.

lineItems.configuration: Serverless General Purpose, 0.5 vCore minimum, one-hour auto-pause, 5 GB data, 5 GB backup.
lineItems.costFormula: 12 vCore-hours (24 hours x 0.5 vCore) x 0.573934 USD + 5 GB data x 0.13685 USD + 5 GB backup x 0.119 USD + 1M IO x 0.238 USD = 8.404458 USD, rounded up = 8.41 USD.

lineItems.configuration: Standard page-metered processing; worst case is every declared page processed twice.
lineItems.costFormula: 1152 pages x 0.0015 USD/page = 1.728 USD, rounded up = 1.73 USD.

lineItems.configuration: Model/version remains the preflight confirmation gate; estimate uses a conservative rate envelope of 5 USD per million input tokens and 15 USD per million output tokens.
lineItems.costFormula: (1200000 input tokens x 5 USD/million) + (300000 output tokens x 15 USD/million) = 10.50 USD.
lineItems.rateReconciliation: The snapshot candidate is gpt-4.1-mini regional at 0.484 USD/million input tokens and 1.936 USD/million output tokens. Because the approved preflight does not select a model/version, the estimate reserves the higher 5 USD/million input and 15 USD/million output envelope; selecting a meter above that envelope blocks apply.

lineItems.configuration: Hot LRS evidence, two retained versions per document, 90-day lifecycle; rounded to 1 GB retained.
lineItems.costFormula: 1 GB-month x 0.0184 USD + 50000 writes / 10000 x 0.05 USD + 50000 reads / 10000 x 0.004 USD = 0.2884 USD, rounded up = 0.29 USD; versions are included in the 1 GB retained allowance.

lineItems.configuration: Analytics ingestion capped at 1 GB/month with 90-day retention; diagnostic volume is sampled and bounded.
lineItems.costFormula: 1 GB ingestion x 2.99 USD (the 5 GB tier rate) + 3 GB retained (1 GB/month x 90 days) x 0.10 USD = 3.29 USD, plus a bounded 0.03 USD rounding allowance = 3.32 USD.

lineItems.configuration: Public, firewall-restricted SQL endpoint from the approved preflight; no private network resources; 1 GB egress allowance.
lineItems.costFormula: 1 GB internet egress is below the 100 GB tier; the snapshot returns 0 USD at tier 0 and 0.08 USD/GB from 100 GB. The estimate conservatively reserves 0.08 USD.

lineItems.configuration: Protected Hot LRS state storage, locking and 10000 state operations; remains outside the disposable demo resource group.
lineItems.costFormula: 1 GB-month x 0.0184 USD + 10000 writes / 10000 x 0.05 USD = 0.0684 USD, rounded up = 0.07 USD.

totals.contingencyBasis: Fixed 50 USD allowance for regional meter changes, small transaction-volume variance and one approved rehearsal-month overrun; it is not permission to spend it.

whenComputeIsStopped: Container Apps replica compute falls to zero at scale-to-zero, but the Container Apps environment and container registry can retain billable state and images.
An auto-paused SQL serverless database stops compute billing while paused, but database storage and retained backup storage continue.
Application Insights and Log Analytics continue to incur ingestion and retained-log charges while data remains in the workspace.
The protected remote Terraform state backend continues to incur storage and operation charges because it is externally owned and not destroyed with the demo.
residualCharges.retention: Evidence blob versions, synthetic fixtures and monitoring logs are retained for 90 days unless an approved cleanup action removes them earlier.
minimumOrResidualItems: SQL database data and backup storage
Application Insights and Log Analytics retention
Container Apps environment and retained container images

disposableDemoResources: Azure Container Registry and retained application images
Demo evidence storage and its retained versions
Demo Azure SQL logical server and database
Demo Azure OpenAI resource/deployment when created under the demo resource group
Demo Application Insights and Log Analytics workspace
externallyOwnedBackendResources: The protected remote Terraform state storage account and lock data
The subscription and tenant supplied as private deployment inputs
Any shared organizational network or policy-managed resource not created by this deployment
ownership.teardownRule: Only disposable demo resources may be removed by demo teardown. The operator must preserve externally owned backend resources and separately confirm their owner and residual cost.

conditions: The exact Azure OpenAI model/version, Standard deployment availability and 30000 TPM quota remain unconfirmed preflight checks.
Document Intelligence regional availability and the selected page meter must be confirmed before apply.
Refresh the cited rates immediately before apply; any rate that exceeds its recorded allowance requires a new estimate.
Budget notifications and operator actions are defined in deployment/budget-response-procedure.md but are not enabled by this record.
